summary: Chandelier Exit: trailing stop lines set three ATRs from the 22-bar highest high and lowest low.
overview: The Chandelier Exit draws trailing stop levels on the price chart: a long stop below price in green and a short stop above price in red.
It hangs the stop from the recent extreme, like a chandelier from a ceiling.
how: Long stop = highest high of 22 bars - 3 x ATR(22). Short stop = lowest low of 22 bars + 3 x ATR(22).
With Ratchet Stops on, the long stop cannot fall and the short stop cannot rise until the close crosses the stop.
use: Some traders use the long stop as a trailing exit level in an uptrend.
Use a close through a stop as a sign the trend may be changing.
Raise or lower the multiplier to make the stop looser or tighter.
Turn on ratchet mode for stops that only move one way.
alerts: Alerts: you can alert on its line crossing a value or the candle close (from the chart's + menu); checked while ZoroCharts is open.
notes: Works on any symbol and timeframe; it only needs candle data.
It follows volatility, so stops move further away when ATR grows.
